title: Wang Mang’s New Policy
synopsis: Wang Mang usurps the throne and launches bold reforms.

fullText.simplified:
王莽新政

    中国有一句老话叫作“富不过三代”，意思是有钱的家族也不可能一直有钱。汉朝的历史也是如此，它并非一帆风顺。比如，在“刘”姓人当皇帝的汉朝，就出现了一位“王”姓的皇帝。这是怎么回事呢？
    汉武帝刘彻逝世以后，刘家不免出现了几个“不靠谱”的皇帝。他们有的为美女着迷，有的为美男陶醉；有的亲近自己的下人，有的宠爱自己的母亲一家，把他们捧到天上……这几个皇帝各有各的不同，却偏偏都不喜欢管理国家。有一个皇帝甚至只坐了皇位二十七天，就被赶下去了。
    到了后来，国家的权力都到了大臣们手里，他们争先恐后，力求控制皇帝。在他们眼里，皇帝根本不像个皇帝，倒像个木偶。你让他往东走，他就不敢往西走。
    就这样过了很多年，一个叫王莽的人胜出了。他是皇帝的亲戚，王莽的爸爸就是皇帝的舅舅。
    那时候，皇帝信任王家的人，觉得他们都是自己的亲戚，一定会帮助自己。但王家的人真不少，皇帝一口气给五个舅舅都封了官。王莽却什么都没得到，因为王莽的爸爸早就死了。但王莽一点儿也没有生气，他每天辛勤学习，钻研古书，还常常去王家舅舅们那儿问好。后来有一天，一个舅舅生病了。他的儿子都忙着工作，王莽却细心地照顾他，坚持了一个多月。这个舅舅非常感动，临死前把王莽推荐给皇帝的妈妈，王莽这才得到了一个当官的机会。
    王莽一直都很有礼貌，还很节约，即使当官了，也和别人不一样。大家都觉得王莽品德高尚，非常尊敬他。
    人嘛，总有梦想，想要往上爬也是很正常的事。王莽就这样，一点一点地往上爬，当的官越来越大。直到有一天，王莽毒死了皇帝，自己坐上了皇帝的位置后，大家才醒悟过来——原来王莽的梦想可不只是当官啊！
    虽说王莽姓王不姓刘，按理来说，是个篡位者。但一开始，老百姓并不怎么讨厌他，反而还有很多人叫好。因为王莽看起来，像是站在老百姓一边的人。
    在那时，农民没有自己的土地，因为土地都被有钱人买走或是抢走了。这些有钱人变成了土地的主人：地主。农民没有土地，穷得吃不起饭了，只能把自己也卖给地主，变成了地主的“奴隶”，每天从早到晚都要种地，种出来的东西却是主人的。他们像地主买来的一头牛、一只羊一样，地主打死他们也不犯法。
    在这种情况下，王莽当皇帝的第一年，就开始了惊天动地的改革：他下令收回全国的土地，并计划把这些收回来的土地分给每一个的农民。不仅如此，王莽还规定，任何人都不能买奴隶，只能请别人来工作，给别人工钱。
    王莽的设想是很好的，他知道自己的国家还有一大部分的人在受苦，他想帮助他们。
    王莽的这一系列政策方针，一开始得到了农民的支持。地主们却不喜欢这个政策，都非常恨王莽。他们不听从王莽，很多人都撒谎说自己没有土地。王莽收回的土地不够分给每个农民，很多农民因为得不到政策所承诺的土地，也开始恨王莽。
    终于，大家日子过不下去了，许多人开始造反。他们找到了刘秀。因为刘秀姓刘，也是刘邦的后人，完全有资格当皇帝。
    一开始，王莽并没有害怕。他手上有四十多万的士兵，刘秀却只有一万多士兵，可以说是实力悬殊。但奇怪的是，刘秀好像有超能力，能预料天气的变化。他挑了个最适当的时机出兵，使得王莽军队在行军过程中遇到了各种不测风云，又是大风又是暴雨，据说天上还掉下陨石，正好砸进了王莽军队中……总之，王莽的四十万人就这样输给了刘秀的一万多人。
    算起来，王莽也只当了十五年的皇帝，就被乱兵杀死了。随后，刘秀当上了皇帝，建立了东汉。

    就這樣過了很多年，一個叫王莽的人勝出了。他是皇帝的親戚，王莽的爸爸就是皇帝的舅舅。

    王莽一直都很有禮貌，還很節約，即使當官了，也和別人不一樣。大家都覺得王莽品德高尚，非常尊敬他。

    雖說王莽姓王不姓劉，按理來說，是個篡位者。但一開始，老百姓並不怎麼討厭他，反而還有很多人叫好。因為王莽看起來，像是站在老百姓一邊的人。
    在那時，農民沒有自己的土地，因為土地都被有錢人買走或是搶走了。這些有錢人變成了土地的主人：地主。農民沒有土地，窮得吃不起飯了，只能把自己也賣給地主，變成了地主的“奴隸”，每天從早到晚都要種地，種出來的東西卻是主人的。他們像地主買來的一頭牛、一隻羊一樣，地主打死他們也不犯法。

Everyone thought that Wang Mang was of high moral character, and everyone respected him very much.

sentences.simplified: 人嘛，总有梦想，想要往上爬也是很正常的事。
sentences.traditional: 人嘛，總有夢想，想要往上爬也是很正常的事。
sentences.pinyin: rén ma zǒng yǒu mèng xiǎng xiǎng yào wǎng shàng pá yě shì hěn zhèng cháng de shì

sentences.simplified: 王莽就这样，一点一点地往上爬，当的官越来越大。
sentences.traditional: 王莽就這樣，一點一點地往上爬，當的官越來越大。
sentences.pinyin: wáng mǎng jiù zhè yàng yì diǎn yì diǎn de wǎng shàng pá dāng de guān yuè lái yuè dà
sentences.english: Everyone has dreams, and wanting to climb up the ladder is very normal.

sentences.simplified: 直到有一天，王莽毒死了皇帝，自己坐上了皇帝的位置后，大家才醒悟过来——
sentences.traditional: 直到有一天，王莽毒死了皇帝，自己坐上了皇帝的位置後，大家才醒悟過來——
sentences.pinyin: zhí dào yǒu yì tiān wáng mǎng dú sǐ le huáng dì zì jǐ zuò shàng le huáng dì de wèi zhi hòu dà jiā cái xǐng wù guò lái
sentences.english: Wang Mang climbed up little by little, and his official positions became more and more important.

sentences.simplified: 原来王莽的梦想可不只是当官啊！
sentences.traditional: 原來王莽的夢想可不只是當官啊！
sentences.pinyin: yuán lái wáng mǎng de mèng xiǎng kě bù zhǐ shì dāng guān a
sentences.english: It wasn’t until after Wang Mang poisoned the emperor one day and became emperor himself that people realized the truth.
It turned out that Wang Mang’s dream was not just to become a government official!

sentences.simplified: 虽说王莽姓王不姓刘，按理来说，是个篡位者。
sentences.traditional: 雖說王莽姓王不姓劉，按理來說，是個篡位者。
sentences.pinyin: suī shuō wáng mǎng xìng wáng bú xìng liú àn lǐ lái shuō shì ge cuàn wèi zhě

sentences.simplified: 但一开始，老百姓并不怎么讨厌他，反而还有很多人叫好。
sentences.traditional: 但一開始，老百姓並不怎麼討厭他，反而還有很多人叫好。
sentences.pinyin: dàn yì kāi shǐ lǎo bǎi xìng bìng bù zěn me tǎo yàn tā fǎn ér hái yǒu hěn duō rén jiào hǎo
sentences.english: Even though Wang Mang’s surname was Wang and not Liu, according to reason, he was a usurper.

sentences.simplified: 因为王莽看起来，像是站在老百姓一边的人。
sentences.traditional: 因為王莽看起來，像是站在老百姓一邊的人。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi wáng mǎng kàn qǐ lái xiàng shì zhàn zài lǎo bǎi xìng yì biān de rén
sentences.english: But in the beginning, the ordinary people didn’t really hate him. On the contrary, many people actually applauded him.
This is because Wang Mang seemed to be someone who was on the side of the ordinary people.

sentences.simplified: 在那时，农民没有自己的土地，因为土地都被有钱人买走或是抢走了。
sentences.traditional: 在那時，農民沒有自己的土地，因為土地都被有錢人買走或是搶走了。
sentences.pinyin: zài nà shí nóng mín méi yǒu zì jǐ de tǔ dì yīn wèi tǔ dì dōu bèi yǒu qián rén mǎi zǒu huò shì qiǎng zǒu le

sentences.simplified: 这些有钱人变成了土地的主人：地主。
sentences.traditional: 這些有錢人變成了土地的主人：地主。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē yǒu qián rén biàn chéng le tǔ dì de zhǔ rén dì zhǔ
sentences.english: At that time, farmers did not have their own land because all of the land was either bought or stolen by rich people.

sentences.simplified: 农民没有土地，穷得吃不起饭了，
sentences.traditional: 農民沒有土地，窮得吃不起飯了，
sentences.pinyin: nóng mín méi yǒu tǔ dì qióng de chī bù qǐ fàn le
sentences.english: These rich people became the owners of the land: landlords.

sentences.simplified: 只能把自己也卖给地主，变成了地主的“奴隶”，
sentences.traditional: 只能把自己也賣給地主，變成了地主的“奴隸”，
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ néng bǎ zì jǐ yě mài gěi dì zhǔ biàn chéng le dì zhǔ de nú lì
sentences.english: The farmers had no land, and they were so poor they couldn’t afford to eat.

sentences.simplified: 每天从早到晚都要种地，种出来的东西却是主人的。
sentences.traditional: 每天從早到晚都要種地，種出來的東西卻是主人的。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān cóng zǎo dào wǎn dōu yào zhòng dì zhòng chu lai de dōng xi què shì zhǔ rén de
sentences.english: They could only sell themselves to the landlord and become the “slaves” of their landlords.

sentences.simplified: 他们像地主买来的一头牛、一只羊一样，地主打死他们也不犯法。
sentences.traditional: 他們像地主買來的一頭牛、一隻羊一樣，地主打死他們也不犯法。
sentences.pinyin: tā men xiàng dì zhǔ mǎi lái de yì tóu niú yì zhī yáng yí yàng dì zhǔ dǎ sǐ tā men yě bú fàn fǎ
sentences.english: They farmed every day from morning to night, yet everything they farmed belonged to the landlords.
They were like cows or sheep bought by the landlord. It was not a crime even for the landlord to beat them to death.

sentences.simplified: 在这种情况下，王莽当皇帝的第一年，就开始了惊天动地的改革：
sentences.traditional: 在這種情況下，王莽當皇帝的第一年，就開始了驚天動地的改革：
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng xià wáng mǎng dāng huáng dì de dì yī nián jiù kāi shǐ le jīng tiān dòng dì de gǎi gé

sentences.simplified: 他下令收回全国的土地，并计划把这些收回来的土地分给每一个的农民。
sentences.traditional: 他下令收回全國的土地，並計劃把這些收回來的土地分給每一個的農民。
sentences.pinyin: tā xià lìng shōu huí quán guó de tǔ dì bìng jì huà bǎ zhè xiē shōu huí lai de tǔ dì fēn gěi měi yí ge de nóng mín
sentences.english: Under these circumstances, in the first year that Wang Mang became emperor, he started an earth-shattering reform:

sentences.simplified: 不仅如此，王莽还规定，任何人都不能买奴隶，
sentences.traditional: 不僅如此，王莽還規定，任何人都不能買奴隸，
sentences.pinyin: bù jǐn rú cǐ wáng mǎng hái guī dìng rèn hé rén dōu bù néng mǎi nú lì
sentences.english: He issued an order to recover all the land in the country and planned to distribute this recovered land to each and every farmer.

sentences.simplified: 只能请别人来工作，给别人工钱。
sentences.traditional: 只能請別人來工作，給別人工錢。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ néng qǐng bié ren lái gōng zuò gěi bié ren gōng qián
sentences.english: In addition, Wang Mang also stipulated that no one could buy slaves.
People could only hire others to work for them by paying them wages.

sentences.simplified: 王莽的设想是很好的，他知道自己的国家还有一大部分的人在受苦，他想帮助他们。
sentences.traditional: 王莽的設想是很好的，他知道自己的國家還有一大部分的人在受苦，他想幫助他們。
sentences.pinyin: wáng mǎng de shè xiǎng shì hěn hǎo de tā zhī dào zì jǐ de guó jiā hái yǒu yí dà bù fen de rén zài shòu kǔ tā xiǎng bāng zhù tā men

sentences.english: Wang Mang’s idea was good. He knew that a large portion of the people in his country were suffering, and he wanted to help them.

sentences.simplified: 王莽的这一系列政策方针，一开始得到了农民的支持。
sentences.traditional: 王莽的這一系列政策方針，一開始得到了農民的支持。
sentences.pinyin: wáng mǎng de zhè yí xì liè zhèng cè fāng zhēn yì kāi shǐ dé dào le nóng mín de zhī chí

sentences.simplified: 地主们却不喜欢这个政策，都非常恨王莽。
sentences.traditional: 地主們卻不喜歡這個政策，都非常恨王莽。
sentences.pinyin: dì zhǔ men què bù xǐ huan zhè ge zhèng cè dōu fēi cháng hèn wáng mǎng
sentences.english: Wang Mang’s series of policies received the support of farmers at the beginning.

sentences.simplified: 他们不听从王莽，很多人都撒谎说自己没有土地。
sentences.traditional: 他們不聽從王莽，很多人都撒謊說自己沒有土地。
sentences.pinyin: tā men bù tīng cóng wáng mǎng hěn duō rén dōu sā huǎng shuō zì jǐ méi yǒu tǔ dì
sentences.english: However, landlords did not like this policy. They all hated Wang Mang.

sentences.simplified: 王莽收回的土地不够分给每个农民，
sentences.traditional: 王莽收回的土地不夠分給每個農民，
sentences.pinyin: wáng mǎng shōu huí de tǔ dì bú gòu fēn gěi měi ge nóng mín
sentences.english: They did not obey Wang Mang. Many people lied, saying that they did not own land.

sentences.simplified: 很多农民因为得不到政策所承诺的土地，也开始恨王莽。
sentences.traditional: 很多農民因為得不到政策所承諾的土地，也開始恨王莽。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō nóng mín yīn wèi dé bú dào zhèng cè suǒ chéng nuò de tǔ dì yě kāi shǐ hèn wáng mǎng
sentences.english: The land that Wang Mang recovered was not enough to distribute to every farmer.
Many farmers also began to hate Wang Mang because they were not able to get the land promised to them under this policy.

sentences.simplified: 终于，大家日子过不下去了，许多人开始造反。他们找到了刘秀。
sentences.traditional: 終於，大家日子過不下去了，許多人開始造反。他們找到了劉秀。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú dà jiā rì zi guò bú xià qù le xǔ duō rén kāi shǐ zào fǎn tā men zhǎo dào le liú xiù

sentences.simplified: 因为刘秀姓刘，也是刘邦的后人，完全有资格当皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 因為劉秀姓劉，也是劉邦的後人，完全有資格當皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi liú xiù xìng liú yě shì liú bāng de hòu rén wán quán yǒu zī gé dāng huáng dì
sentences.english: Eventually, people could not live like this any longer, and many people began to rebel. They found Liu Xiu.
Because Liu Xiu’s surname was Liu and he was a descendant of Liu Bang, he was fully qualified to become emperor.

sentences.simplified: 一开始，王莽并没有害怕。
sentences.traditional: 一開始，王莽並沒有害怕。
sentences.pinyin: yì kāi shǐ wáng mǎng bìng méi yǒu hài pà

sentences.simplified: 他手上有四十多万的士兵，刘秀却只有一万多士兵，
sentences.traditional: 他手上有四十多萬的士兵，劉秀卻只有一萬多士兵，
sentences.pinyin: tā shǒu shang yǒu sì shí duō wàn de shì bīng liú xiù què zhǐ yǒu yí wàn duō shì bīng
sentences.english: At first, Wang Mang was not afraid.

sentences.simplified: 可以说是实力悬殊。
sentences.traditional: 可以說是實力懸殊。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ shuō shì shí lì xuán shū
sentences.english: He had more than 400,000 soldiers on hand, while Liu Xiu only had little more than 10,000 soldiers.

sentences.simplified: 但奇怪的是，刘秀好像有超能力，能预料天气的变化。
sentences.traditional: 但奇怪的是，劉秀好像有超能力，能預料天氣的變化。
sentences.pinyin: dàn qí guài de shì liú xiù hǎo xiàng yǒu chāo néng lì néng yù liào tiān qì de biàn huà
sentences.english: It could be said that there was a great difference in strength between the two.

sentences.simplified: 他挑了个最适当的时机出兵，
sentences.traditional: 他挑了個最適當的時機出兵，
sentences.pinyin: tā tiāo le ge zuì shì dàng de shí jī chū bīng
sentences.english: But strangely enough, Liu Xiu seemed to have supernatural powers. He could anticipate changes in the weather.

sentences.simplified: 使得王莽军队在行军过程中遇到了各种不测风云，又是大风又是暴雨，
sentences.traditional: 使得王莽軍隊在行軍過程中遇到了各種不測風雲，又是大風又是暴雨，
sentences.pinyin: shǐ de wáng mǎng jūn duì zài xíng jūn guò chéng zhōng yù dào le gè zhǒng bú cè fēng yún yòu shì dà fēng yòu shì bào yǔ
sentences.english: He chose the most appropriate time to send troops out, ..

sentences.simplified: 据说天上还掉下陨石，正好砸进了王莽军队中……
sentences.traditional: 據說天上還掉下隕石，正好砸進了王莽軍隊中……
sentences.pinyin: jù shuō tiān shang hái diào xià yǔn shí zhèng hǎo zá jìn le wáng mǎng jūn duì zhōng
sentences.english: .. causing Wang Mang’s troops to encounter many unpredictable storms when marching, with both strong winds and heavy rain.

sentences.simplified: 总之，王莽的四十万人就这样输给了刘秀的一万多人。
sentences.traditional: 總之，王莽的四十萬人就這樣輸給了劉秀的一萬多人。
sentences.pinyin: zǒng zhī wáng mǎng de sì shí wàn rén jiù zhè yàng shū gěi le liú xiù de yí wàn duō rén
sentences.english: It was said that a meteorite also fell from the sky and just so happened to hit Wang Mang’s troops …
In short, the 400,000 men of Wang Mang lost to the little over 10,000 men of Liu Xiu just like that.

sentences.simplified: 算起来，王莽也只当了十五年的皇帝，就被乱兵杀死了。
sentences.traditional: 算起來，王莽也只當了十五年的皇帝，就被亂兵殺死了。
sentences.pinyin: suàn qǐ lái wáng mǎng yě zhǐ dāng le shí wǔ nián de huáng dì jiù bèi luàn bīng shā sǐ le

sentences.simplified: 随后，刘秀当上了皇帝，建立了东汉。
sentences.traditional: 隨後，劉秀當上了皇帝，建立了東漢。
sentences.pinyin: suí hòu liú xiù dāng shàng le huáng dì jiàn lì le dōng hàn
sentences.english: All told, Wang Mang was only emperor for 15 years before he was killed by rebellious troops.

sentence_translations: Wang Mang’s New Policy
In China, there is an old saying that goes, “wealth does not last more than three generations”.
This means that rich families cannot stay rich forever.
The history of the Han Dynasty was no different; it was not all smooth sailing.
For example, in the Han Dynasty, when people with the surname “Liu” were emperors, there appeared an emperor with the surname “Wang”.
What was going on here?
After the death of Emperor Wu of Han, Liu Che, there were inevitably several “unreliable” emperors from the Liu family.
Some of them were captivated by beautiful women; some were intoxicated by handsome men.
Some became intimate with their own servants; some doted on their mother’s family and praised them to the heavens …
These emperors were all different in their own way, but none of them liked to manage the country.
In fact, one emperor only sat on the throne for 27 days before being deposed.
Later, the power of the state fell into the hands of the ministers, who fought each other, striving to control the emperor.
In their eyes, the emperor did not seem like an emperor at all; he seemed more like a puppet.
If you wanted him to go east, he wouldn’t dare go west.
After this went on for many years, a man named Wang Mang was victorious.
He was a relative of the emperor—Wang Mang’s father was the emperor’s maternal uncle.
At that time, the emperor trusted the Wang family. He felt that they were all his relatives and would surely help him.
But the Wang family had a lot of people. The emperor bestowed official positions upon five maternal uncles all at once.
Wang Mang, however, did not get anything because Wang Mang’s father had died a long time ago.
But, Wang Mang was not angry at all. He studied hard every day, delving into ancient texts.
He also often visited the maternal uncles of the Wang family to say hello.
Then one day, one of the maternal uncles fell ill.
His sons were all busy working, but Wang Mang attentively cared for him, preserving for more than a month.
This maternal uncle was very moved. As he was facing death, he recommended Wang Mang to the emperor’s mother.
Only then did Wang Mang get the opportunity to become a government official.
Wang Mang was always very polite and very frugal. Even though he became a government official, he was not like the others.
Everyone thought that Wang Mang was of high moral character, and everyone respected him very much.
Everyone has dreams, and wanting to climb up the ladder is very normal.
Wang Mang climbed up little by little, and his official positions became more and more important.
It wasn’t until after Wang Mang poisoned the emperor one day and became emperor himself that people realized the truth.
It turned out that Wang Mang’s dream was not just to become a government official!
Even though Wang Mang’s surname was Wang and not Liu, according to reason, he was a usurper.
But in the beginning, the ordinary people didn’t really hate him. On the contrary, many people actually applauded him.
This is because Wang Mang seemed to be someone who was on the side of the ordinary people.
At that time, farmers did not have their own land because all of the land was either bought or stolen by rich people.
These rich people became the owners of the land: landlords.
The farmers had no land, and they were so poor they couldn’t afford to eat.
They could only sell themselves to the landlord and become the “slaves” of their landlords.
They farmed every day from morning to night, yet everything they farmed belonged to the landlords.
They were like cows or sheep bought by the landlord. It was not a crime even for the landlord to beat them to death.
Under these circumstances, in the first year that Wang Mang became emperor, he started an earth-shattering reform:
He issued an order to recover all the land in the country and planned to distribute this recovered land to each and every farmer.
In addition, Wang Mang also stipulated that no one could buy slaves.
People could only hire others to work for them by paying them wages.
Wang Mang’s idea was good. He knew that a large portion of the people in his country were suffering, and he wanted to help them.
Wang Mang’s series of policies received the support of farmers at the beginning.
However, landlords did not like this policy. They all hated Wang Mang.
They did not obey Wang Mang. Many people lied, saying that they did not own land.
The land that Wang Mang recovered was not enough to distribute to every farmer.
Many farmers also began to hate Wang Mang because they were not able to get the land promised to them under this policy.
Eventually, people could not live like this any longer, and many people began to rebel. They found Liu Xiu.
Because Liu Xiu’s surname was Liu and he was a descendant of Liu Bang, he was fully qualified to become emperor.
At first, Wang Mang was not afraid.
He had more than 400,000 soldiers on hand, while Liu Xiu only had little more than 10,000 soldiers.
It could be said that there was a great difference in strength between the two.
But strangely enough, Liu Xiu seemed to have supernatural powers. He could anticipate changes in the weather.
He chose the most appropriate time to send troops out, ..
.. causing Wang Mang’s troops to encounter many unpredictable storms when marching, with both strong winds and heavy rain.
It was said that a meteorite also fell from the sky and just so happened to hit Wang Mang’s troops …
In short, the 400,000 men of Wang Mang lost to the little over 10,000 men of Liu Xiu just like that.
All told, Wang Mang was only emperor for 15 years before he was killed by rebellious troops.
Afterward, Liu Xiu became emperor and established the Eastern Han Dynasty.
